experiences.name: Mercado de Medellín Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Mexico City's most vibrant local markets, just minutes from Doctores. Sample fresh tacos, tlayudas, tamales, and tropical fruits while chatting with local vendors. A true immersion into everyday chilango food culture.

experiences.name: Tacos de Canasta in Tepito & La Merced
experiences.description: Join a self-guided street food crawl through the legendary La Merced market area, sampling tacos de canasta, quesillo, and aguas frescas. Experience the raw, authentic pulse of working-class Mexico City cuisine at its most affordable and delicious.
experiences.location: La Merced, Centro Histórico, Mexico City

experiences.name: Museo Nacional de Arte (MUNAL) Visit
experiences.description: Discover centuries of Mexican art from colonial paintings to 20th-century masterpieces at this stunning neoclassical palace. The museum offers deep insight into Mexican identity, history, and artistic heritage at a very accessible price.

experiences.name: Lucha Libre Night at Arena México
experiences.description: Attend a thrilling Lucha Libre wrestling event at the world-famous Arena México, located just blocks from Doctores. This iconic Mexican spectacle blends acrobatics, drama, and colorful masked wrestlers — a bucket-list cultural experience unique to Mexico.

experiences.name: Cooking Class: Traditional Mexican Cuisine
experiences.description: Join a hands-on cooking class in the Roma or Doctores area where a local chef teaches you to prepare mole, chiles en nogada, and handmade tortillas. Learn the history and technique behind Mexico's UNESCO-recognized culinary heritage.
